data.rationale: The proposal gets the procedure, its order, both parameters and the note template right, but it leaves out the step that sets servings to {servings} on the recipe page and changes "first recipe with a rating" to the vaguer "highest-rated matching recipe", so an automation built from it would pick recipes differently and skip the servings adjustment.
